activities.title: Performance Bottleneck Hunt
activities.instruction: Inspect a slow interface and identify which operation is creating unnecessary work.

content.concept: Find frontend performance bottlenecks by identifying expensive rendering, unnecessary work or oversized resources.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Performance Strategy Compare
activities.instruction: Compare rendering strategies and identify which change reduces unnecessary initial work.

content.concept: Recognize how rendering strategy, resource size and unnecessary work affect frontend responsiveness.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Load expensive features only when needed
Duplicate the same data and UI work
config.answer: Load expensive features only when needed

activities.title: Lazy Loading Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of route-level lazy loading.

content.concept: Understand how lazy loading delays loading code until the corresponding feature or route is needed.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Performance Audit
activities.instruction: Inspect audit findings and identify which issues should be investigated first.

content.concept: Use browser performance and auditing tools to identify measurable opportunities for improvement.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: A large bundle can increase download and parsing work.
Large or improperly sized images can increase page load cost.
Long tasks can block the main thread and reduce responsiveness.
Unused resources can add unnecessary network and processing work.
